## Overview: Running `AtaCNV` (`XiDsLab/AtaCNV`) on Our Multiome Dataset

This notebook implements single-cell ATAC Copy Number Variation/Alteration (CNV/CNA) detection directly using the **`AtaCNV`** R package ([`https://github.com/XiDsLab/AtaCNV`](https://github.com/XiDsLab/AtaCNV/tree/main), Wang et al., *Cell Reports Methods* 2024), strictly following the official package workflow in `README.md` and `tutorial.R`:

1. **Input Matrix Generation (`count` & `cell_info`):**
   - Imports our processed Multiome Seurat object (`<sample_id>_multiome_merged_with_chromvar.rds` or `<sample_id>_multiome_merged.rds`).
   - Builds the **cell-by-bin** read count matrix (`count`, 3,102 1 Mbp bins across `hg38` defined in `AtaCNV`'s `bin_info_hg38` / `chr_length_hg38`, with column names formatted via `AtaCNV::bin2str()`) and the `cell_info` data frame (`cluster` and `cell_type` = `"normal"` vs. `"tumor"`).
2. **Normalization Module (`AtaCNV::normalize` & `AtaCNV::plot_heatmap`):**
   - Runs `AtaCNV::normalize()` (`dlm` Kalman smoothing + `edgeR::cpm` + normal baseline deconvolution + LOESS `gc_correction = TRUE`) and plots the pre-segmentation copy ratio heatmap via `AtaCNV::plot_heatmap()`.
3. **Segmentation Module (`AtaCNV::calculate_CNV`, `AtaCNV::calculate_CNV_arm_level` & `AtaCNV::plot_heatmap`):**
   - Runs multi-sample `BICseq2` joint segmentation via `AtaCNV::calculate_CNV()` (and chromosome-arm level calling via `AtaCNV::calculate_CNV_arm_level()`) and plots the segmented copy ratio heatmap via `AtaCNV::plot_heatmap()`.
4. **CNV Burden Score & Copy State Inference (`AtaCNV::CNV_score` & `AtaCNV::estimate_cnv_state_cluster`):**
   - Computes cluster CNV burden scores via `AtaCNV::CNV_score()`, infers discrete copy number states via `AtaCNV::estimate_cnv_state_cluster()`, and projects the `AtaCNV` results back onto the Seurat object's UMAP (`wnn.umap` / `umap`).

---

## 1. Install & Load `AtaCNV` (`XiDsLab/AtaCNV`)

If `AtaCNV` is not yet installed on the server, run the installation block below once in your R console (or let the chunk install it automatically):

```{r install_and_load_atacnv}
# Install required CRAN / Bioconductor dependencies listed in XiDsLab/AtaCNV/DESCRIPTION
cran_deps <- c("dlm", "irlba", "parallelDist", "circlize", "RColorBrewer", "devtools")
missing_cran <- cran_deps[!vapply(cran_deps, requireNamespace, logical(1), quietly = TRUE)]
if (length(missing_cran) > 0) {
  install.packages(missing_cran, repos = "https://cloud.r-project.org")
}

bioc_deps <- c("edgeR", "ComplexHeatmap")
missing_bioc <- bioc_deps[!vapply(bioc_deps, requireNamespace, logical(1), quietly = TRUE)]
if (length(missing_bioc) > 0) {
  BiocManager::install(missing_bioc, update = FALSE, ask = FALSE)
}

# Install XiDsLab/AtaCNV from GitHub if not already installed
if (!requireNamespace("AtaCNV", quietly = TRUE)) {
  devtools::install_github("XiDsLab/AtaCNV", upgrade = "never")
}

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(AtaCNV)
  library(Seurat)
  library(Signac)
  library(BSgenome.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg38)
  library(Biostrings)
  library(GenomicRanges)
  library(Matrix)
  library(ComplexHeatmap)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(patchwork)
  library(dplyr)
})
```

### Ensure `AtaCNV` `hg38` Reference Data & `MBICseq` Binary Permissions Are Ready

In `XiDsLab/AtaCNV`:
1. The bundled Linux binary `inst/BICseq2/MBICseq` is stored in Git without `+x` executable permissions (`-rw-r--r--`), so we set `Sys.chmod(..., "0755")` so `AtaCNV::calculate_CNV()` can invoke `MBICseq` cleanly.
2. In `data/bin_info_hg38.rda`, the `gc` column used by `AtaCNV::normalize(..., genome = "hg38", gc_correction = TRUE)` is missing (unlike `bin_info_hg19.rda`). The helper below populates `bin_info_hg38$gc` from `BSgenome.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg38` inside the installed `AtaCNV` package `data/bin_info_hg38.rda` if missing.

```{r prepare_atacnv_hg38}
# 1. Ensure MBICseq Linux binary inside AtaCNV is executable (+x)
mbic_path <- system.file("BICseq2", "MBICseq", package = "AtaCNV")
if (nzchar(mbic_path) && file.exists(mbic_path)) {
  Sys.chmod(mbic_path, mode = "0755")
  cat("Verified executable permission on AtaCNV MBICseq binary:\n  ", mbic_path, "\n")
}

# 2. Ensure bin_info_hg38 in AtaCNV has the $gc column required by AtaCNV::normalize(gc_correction = TRUE)
data("bin_info_hg38", package = "AtaCNV")
if (is.null(bin_info_hg38$gc)) {
  cat("Populating missing 'gc' column in AtaCNV's bin_info_hg38 from BSgenome.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg38...\n")
  bin_gr_hg38 <- GenomicRanges::GRanges(
    seqnames = bin_info_hg38$chr,
    ranges   = IRanges::IRanges(start = bin_info_hg38$start + 1, end = bin_info_hg38$end)
  )
  seqs <- Biostrings::getSeq(BSgenome.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg38, bin_gr_hg38)
  freq <- Biostrings::alphabetFrequency(seqs, baseOnly = TRUE)
  atgc <- rowSums(freq[, c("A", "C", "G", "T"), drop = FALSE])
  bin_info_hg38$gc <- ifelse(atgc > 0, (freq[, "G"] + freq[, "C"]) / atgc, 0.41)
  
  # Save updated bin_info_hg38.rda into the installed AtaCNV package data directory
  # and unregister it from Rdata.rds so utils::data("bin_info_hg38") loads the updated .rda
  pkg_data_dir <- system.file("data", package = "AtaCNV")
  if (nzchar(pkg_data_dir) && file.access(pkg_data_dir, 2) == 0) {
    pkg_rda_path <- file.path(pkg_data_dir, "bin_info_hg38.rda")
    save(bin_info_hg38, file = pkg_rda_path)
    rdata_rds <- file.path(pkg_data_dir, "Rdata.rds")
    if (file.exists(rdata_rds)) {
      rds_idx <- readRDS(rdata_rds)
      rds_idx[["bin_info_hg38"]] <- NULL
      saveRDS(rds_idx, rdata_rds)
    }
    cat("Updated bin_info_hg38.rda with GC content in:", pkg_data_dir, "\n")
  }
}
```

## 2. Configure Sample Paths & Load Processed Multiome Object

```{r config_and_load}
# 1. Sample Identifier
sample_id <- "GG001AC"

# 2. Path to processed Multiome Seurat object (.rds)
output_dir <- paste0("./outputs/test_", sample_id)
chromvar_rds_path <- file.path(output_dir, paste0(sample_id, "_multiome_merged_with_chromvar.rds"))
multiome_rds_path <- file.path(output_dir, paste0(sample_id, "_multiome_merged.rds"))

# 3. Path to 10x ATAC fragments file (atac_fragments.tsv.gz)
fragments_path <- paste0(
  "/data-pure/sequencing/ngs/NGS2026_10893/HG38/count/cellranger/",
  sample_id, "/atac_fragments.tsv.gz"
)

# 4. Output directory for AtaCNV files (must end with "/" as required by AtaCNV)
cna_out_dir <- paste0(file.path(output_dir, "AtaCNV"), "/")
dir.create(cna_out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

# 5. Cell-type metadata column in multiome_obj ("ScType" or "Azimuth_cellType")
preferred_celltype_col <- "ScType"

# 6. Non-neoplastic cell types to label as "normal" in cell_info$cell_type
normal_celltype_patterns <- c(
  "microglia", "micro-pvm", "macrophage", "immune", "t cell", "nk cell", "b cell", "monocyte",
  "endothelial", "endo", "pericyte", "vlmc", "vascular",
  "oligodendrocyte", "oligo"
)

# 7. How to generate the 3,102-bin cell-by-bin count matrix:
#   - use_atacnv_generate_input = FALSE (Recommended): Quantifies the exact 3,102 bins from
#     AtaCNV's chr_length_hg38 / bin_info_hg38 via Signac::FeatureMatrix (takes ~30 seconds)
#   - use_atacnv_generate_input = TRUE: Calls AtaCNV::generate_input() (pure-R line-by-line reader)
use_atacnv_generate_input <- FALSE

# Load Multiome Seurat object
input_rds <- if (file.exists(chromvar_rds_path)) chromvar_rds_path else multiome_rds_path
if (!file.exists(input_rds)) {
  stop("Processed Multiome RDS file not found at: ", input_rds)
}
cat("Loading processed Multiome Seurat object from:", input_rds, "\n")
multiome_obj <- readRDS(input_rds)
cat("Loaded", ncol(multiome_obj), "cells.\n")

# Verify or re-attach ATAC Fragment file
DefaultAssay(multiome_obj) <- "ATAC"
frag_list <- Fragments(multiome_obj[["ATAC"]])
if (length(frag_list) == 0 || !file.exists(GetFragmentData(frag_list[[1]], slot = "path"))) {
  Fragments(multiome_obj[["ATAC"]]) <- NULL
  Fragments(multiome_obj[["ATAC"]]) <- CreateFragmentObject(
    path  = fragments_path,
    cells = colnames(multiome_obj),
    validate.fragments = FALSE
  )
}
```

---

## 3. Build `cell_info` & `count` Input Matrix (`tutorial.R` Setup)

In [`tutorial.R`](https://github.com/XiDsLab/AtaCNV/blob/main/tutorial.R), `AtaCNV` expects two inputs:
1. **`cell_info`:** A data frame indexed by cell barcodes containing:
   - `cell_info$cluster`: Cell cluster / cell-type identity (`ScType` or `Azimuth_cellType`).
   - `cell_info$cell_type`: `"normal"` for reference diploid cells vs. `"tumor"` for query/candidate tumor cells.
2. **`count`:** A **cell-by-bin** matrix (`nrow = cells`, `ncol = 3102` 1 Mbp bins from `data("bin_info_hg38")`), where `rownames(count)` are cell barcodes and `colnames(count)` are formatted via `AtaCNV::bin2str(bin_info_hg38)` (`"chr1_0_1e+06"`, `"chr1_1e+06_2e+06"`, ...).

```{r build_cell_info_and_count}
# 1. Construct cell_info matching tutorial.R
candidate_cols <- unique(c(preferred_celltype_col, "ScType", "Azimuth_cellType", "seurat_clusters"))
celltype_col <- intersect(candidate_cols, colnames(multiome_obj@meta.data))[1]

cluster_vec <- as.character(multiome_obj@meta.data[[celltype_col]])
cluster_vec[is.na(cluster_vec) | cluster_vec == ""] <- "Unannotated"

azimuth_vec <- if ("Azimuth_cellType" %in% colnames(multiome_obj@meta.data)) {
  as.character(multiome_obj$Azimuth_cellType)
} else {
  rep("", ncol(multiome_obj))
}

pattern_regex <- paste(normal_celltype_patterns, collapse = "|")
is_normal <- grepl(pattern_regex, tolower(cluster_vec)) | grepl(pattern_regex, tolower(azimuth_vec))

cell_info <- data.frame(
  cluster   = cluster_vec,
  cell_type = ifelse(is_normal, "normal", "tumor"),
  row.names = colnames(multiome_obj),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

cat("Summary of cell_info (matching XiDsLab/AtaCNV/tutorial.R):\n")
print(table(Cluster = cell_info$cluster, Type = cell_info$cell_type))
saveRDS(cell_info, file = paste0(cna_out_dir, "cell_info.rds"))

# 2. Construct or load the 3,102-column cell-by-bin count matrix for hg38
count_rds_path <- paste0(cna_out_dir, "input.rds")
data("bin_info_hg38", package = "AtaCNV")

if (file.exists(count_rds_path)) {
  cat("Loading cached AtaCNV input count matrix from:", count_rds_path, "\n")
  count <- readRDS(count_rds_path)
} else if (isTRUE(use_atacnv_generate_input)) {
  cat("Running AtaCNV::generate_input() on fragment file...\n")
  AtaCNV::generate_input(
    fragment_file = fragments_path,
    cell_barcodes = rownames(cell_info),
    genome        = "hg38",
    output_dir    = cna_out_dir
  )
  count <- readRDS(count_rds_path)
} else {
  cat("Quantifying fragments across AtaCNV's 3,102 hg38 1 Mbp bins (bin_info_hg38)...\n")
  atacnv_bins_gr <- GenomicRanges::GRanges(
    seqnames = bin_info_hg38$chr,
    ranges   = IRanges::IRanges(start = bin_info_hg38$start + 1, end = bin_info_hg38$end)
  )
  bin_feature_mat <- Signac::FeatureMatrix(
    fragments = Fragments(multiome_obj[["ATAC"]]),
    features  = atacnv_bins_gr,
    cells     = rownames(cell_info),
    verbose   = TRUE
  )
  # Transpose to cell-by-bin (rows = cells, cols = 3,102 bins) as required by AtaCNV
  count <- t(as.matrix(bin_feature_mat[, rownames(cell_info), drop = FALSE]))
  
  # Format column names using AtaCNV::bin2str(bin_info_hg38)
  colnames(count) <- AtaCNV::bin2str(bin_info_hg38)
  rownames(count) <- rownames(cell_info)
  saveRDS(count, file = count_rds_path)
  cat("Saved cell-by-bin count matrix (", nrow(count), "x", ncol(count), ") to:", count_rds_path, "\n")
}

# Ensure column names are formatted with AtaCNV::bin2str(bin_info_hg38)
colnames(count) <- AtaCNV::bin2str(bin_info_hg38)
cat("count matrix dimensions (cells x bins):", dim(count)[1], "x", dim(count)[2], "\n")
```

## 4. Module 1: `AtaCNV::normalize()` & Pre-Segmentation `AtaCNV::plot_heatmap()`

Following [`tutorial.R`](https://github.com/XiDsLab/AtaCNV/blob/main/tutorial.R#L18-L46):
- If `cell_info$cell_type == "normal"` contains at least 20 reference normal cells, we run **Option 2 (`mode = "normal cells"`)**.
- Otherwise, we run **Option 3/4 (`mode = "all cells"` / `mode = "none"`)** with `cell_cluster = cell_info$cluster`.
- We then call **`AtaCNV::plot_heatmap()`** to visualize `norm_re$copy_ratio`.

```{r atacnv_normalize}
norm_rds_path <- paste0(cna_out_dir, "norm_re.rds")

n_normal <- sum(cell_info$cell_type == "normal")
norm_mode <- if (n_normal >= 20) "normal cells" else "all cells"
cat(sprintf("Running AtaCNV::normalize() with genome = 'hg38', mode = '%s' (n_normal = %d)...\n",
            norm_mode, n_normal))

norm_re <- AtaCNV::normalize(
  count         = count,
  genome        = "hg38",
  mode          = norm_mode,
  normal_cells  = if (norm_mode == "normal cells") (cell_info$cell_type == "normal") else "none",
  cell_cluster  = cell_info$cluster,
  gc_correction = TRUE,
  output_dir    = cna_out_dir,
  output_name   = "norm_re.rds"
)

# Match retained cells (f2 filter inside AtaCNV::normalize)
kept_cells <- rownames(norm_re$copy_ratio)
cell_info_kept <- cell_info[kept_cells, , drop = FALSE]

# Visualize copy ratio after normalization using AtaCNV::plot_heatmap()
cat("Running AtaCNV::plot_heatmap() on normalized copy ratios...\n")
AtaCNV::plot_heatmap(
  copy_ratio      = norm_re$copy_ratio,
  cell_cluster    = cell_info_kept$cluster,
  cell_annotation = cell_info_kept$cell_type,
  output_dir      = cna_out_dir,
  output_name     = paste0(sample_id, "_copy_ratio_norm.png")
)
AtaCNV::plot_heatmap(
  copy_ratio      = norm_re$copy_ratio,
  cell_cluster    = cell_info_kept$cluster,
  cell_annotation = cell_info_kept$cell_type,
  output_dir      = cna_out_dir,
  output_name     = paste0(sample_id, "_copy_ratio_norm.pdf")
)

knitr::include_graphics(paste0(cna_out_dir, sample_id, "_copy_ratio_norm.png"))
```

---

## 5. Module 2: `AtaCNV::calculate_CNV()` Segmentation & Post-Segmentation `AtaCNV::plot_heatmap()`

Following [`tutorial.R`](https://github.com/XiDsLab/AtaCNV/blob/main/tutorial.R#L48-L58) and `README.md`:
- We run **`AtaCNV::calculate_CNV()`** (which uses `MBICseq` to jointly segment all cells and returns `list(copy_ratio = CNV, bkp = bkp, CNV_seg = CNV_re)`).
- *(Note: If the precompiled `MBICseq` binary in `AtaCNV` is incompatible with the cluster's glibc/CPU architecture, we automatically fall back to `AtaCNV::calculate_CNV_arm_level()`).*
- We then call **`AtaCNV::plot_heatmap()`** on `CNV_re$copy_ratio`.

```{r atacnv_segmentation}
cat("Running AtaCNV::calculate_CNV() for multi-sample BIC-seq segmentation...\n")

# Use downsample = 1000 as recommended in ?AtaCNV::calculate_CNV if > 1500 cells
ds_val <- if (nrow(norm_re$norm_count) > 1500) 1000 else 0

CNV_re <- tryCatch({
  AtaCNV::calculate_CNV(
    norm_count  = norm_re$norm_count,
    baseline    = norm_re$baseline,
    lambda      = 5,
    downsample  = ds_val,
    output_dir  = cna_out_dir,
    output_name = "CNV_re.rds"
  )
}, error = function(e) {
  message("Note: MBICseq binary execution failed (", e$message,
          "); running AtaCNV::calculate_CNV_arm_level() instead...")
  AtaCNV::calculate_CNV_arm_level(
    norm_count  = norm_re$norm_count,
    baseline    = if (is.matrix(norm_re$baseline)) colMeans(norm_re$baseline) else norm_re$baseline,
    genome      = "hg38",
    output_dir  = cna_out_dir,
    output_name = "CNV_re.rds"
  )
})

# Visualize copy ratio after segmentation using AtaCNV::plot_heatmap()
cat("Running AtaCNV::plot_heatmap() on segmented copy ratios (CNV_re$copy_ratio)...\n")
AtaCNV::plot_heatmap(
  copy_ratio      = CNV_re$copy_ratio,
  cell_cluster    = cell_info_kept$cluster,
  cell_annotation = cell_info_kept$cell_type,
  output_dir      = cna_out_dir,
  output_name     = paste0(sample_id, "_CNV_segmented.png")
)
AtaCNV::plot_heatmap(
  copy_ratio      = CNV_re$copy_ratio,
  cell_cluster    = cell_info_kept$cluster,
  cell_annotation = cell_info_kept$cell_type,
  output_dir      = cna_out_dir,
  output_name     = paste0(sample_id, "_CNV_segmented.pdf")
)

knitr::include_graphics(paste0(cna_out_dir, sample_id, "_CNV_segmented.png"))
```

---

## 6. Module 3: Cluster CNV Burden Score (`AtaCNV::CNV_score`) & Discrete State Inference (`AtaCNV::estimate_cnv_state_cluster`)

1. **`AtaCNV::CNV_score()`:** Computes the cluster-level CNV burden score defined in `R/downstream.R`. *(Note: `AtaCNV::CNV_score` internally references `colnames(CNV)` on line 16 of `downstream.R`, so we assign `CNV <- CNV_re$copy_ratio` first).*
2. **`AtaCNV::estimate_cnv_state_cluster()`:** Infers discrete copy number states (`0.5` = loss, `1.0` = neutral, `1.5` = gain) if `simATAC` (`bowang-lab/simATAC`) is installed.

```{r atacnv_cnv_score_and_states}
# 1. Calculate cluster-level CNV burden scores using AtaCNV::CNV_score()
CNV <- CNV_re$copy_ratio
cluster_cnv_scores <- AtaCNV::CNV_score(
  copy_ratio = CNV_re$copy_ratio,
  cluster    = cell_info_kept$cluster,
  delXY      = TRUE
)
names(cluster_cnv_scores) <- kept_cells

# Also compute per-cell CNV burden (mean squared deviation from 1.0 across autosomal bins)
bins_seg <- AtaCNV::str2bin(colnames(CNV_re$copy_ratio))
autosomal_mask <- !(bins_seg$chr %in% c("chrX", "chrY"))
cell_cnv_burden <- rowMeans((CNV_re$copy_ratio[, autosomal_mask, drop = FALSE] - 1)^2, na.rm = TRUE)

# 2. Optional: Discrete copy state inference via AtaCNV::estimate_cnv_state_cluster()
# Requires bowang-lab/simATAC and bin_info_hg38$map > 500000
if (requireNamespace("simATAC", quietly = TRUE) && sum(cell_info_kept$cell_type == "normal") > 5) {
  cat("Running AtaCNV::estimate_cnv_state_cluster()...\n")
  # Label normal cells as "normal" and tumor cells by their cluster
  state_label <- ifelse(cell_info_kept$cell_type == "normal", "normal", cell_info_kept$cluster)
  CN_state <- tryCatch({
    AtaCNV::estimate_cnv_state_cluster(
      count      = count[kept_cells, , drop = FALSE],
      genome     = "hg38",
      copy_ratio = norm_re$copy_ratio,
      bkp        = CNV_re$bkp,
      label      = state_label
    )
  }, error = function(e) {
    message("Note: estimate_cnv_state_cluster skipped (", e$message, ")")
    NULL
  })
  if (!is.null(CN_state)) {
    saveRDS(CN_state, file = paste0(cna_out_dir, "CN_state.rds"))
  }
} else {
  cat("Skipping optional AtaCNV::estimate_cnv_state_cluster() (requires 'bowang-lab/simATAC').\n")
}
```

---

## 7. Integrate `AtaCNV` Outputs Back into `multiome_obj` & Plot on UMAP

We store the `AtaCNV` results in `multiome_obj`:
- `multiome_obj$AtaCNV_cluster_score` (output of `AtaCNV::CNV_score()`),
- `multiome_obj$AtaCNV_cell_burden` (single-cell CNV burden from `CNV_re$copy_ratio`),
- `multiome_obj$AtaCNV_chr7_ratio` (mean segmented copy ratio on `chr7` encompassing *BRAF*), and
- `multiome_obj[["AtaCNV"]]` (Seurat assay containing `t(CNV_re$copy_ratio)`).

```{r attach_to_seurat_and_plot, fig.width=15, fig.height=10}
# Attach cluster CNV score and single-cell CNV burden to multiome_obj@meta.data
multiome_obj$AtaCNV_cluster_score <- NA_real_
multiome_obj$AtaCNV_cell_burden   <- NA_real_
multiome_obj$AtaCNV_chr7_ratio    <- NA_real_

multiome_obj@meta.data[kept_cells, "AtaCNV_cluster_score"] <- cluster_cnv_scores[kept_cells]
multiome_obj@meta.data[kept_cells, "AtaCNV_cell_burden"]   <- cell_cnv_burden[kept_cells]

chr7_cols <- bins_seg$chr == "chr7"
if (any(chr7_cols)) {
  multiome_obj@meta.data[kept_cells, "AtaCNV_chr7_ratio"] <- rowMeans(
    CNV_re$copy_ratio[kept_cells, chr7_cols, drop = FALSE],
    na.rm = TRUE
  )
}

# Attach segmented copy ratios as a Seurat Assay ("AtaCNV")
if (identical( kept_cells, colnames(multiome_obj) )) {
  multiome_obj[["AtaCNV"]] <- Seurat::CreateAssayObject(data = t(CNV_re$copy_ratio))
}

# Plot on Joint WNN UMAP (or RNA UMAP)
umap_red <- if ("wnn.umap" %in% names(multiome_obj@reductions)) "wnn.umap" else "umap"

p1 <- DimPlot(multiome_obj, reduction = umap_red, group.by = celltype_col, label = TRUE, repel = TRUE) +
  ggtitle(paste0(sample_id, " - ", celltype_col))

p2 <- FeaturePlot(multiome_obj, reduction = umap_red, features = "AtaCNV_cluster_score",
                  cols = c("grey90", "orange", "firebrick")) +
  ggtitle("AtaCNV::CNV_score (Cluster Burden)")

p3 <- FeaturePlot(multiome_obj, reduction = umap_red, features = "AtaCNV_cell_burden",
                  cols = c("grey90", "orange", "firebrick")) +
  ggtitle("Single-Cell CNV Burden (CNV_re$copy_ratio)")

p4 <- FeaturePlot(multiome_obj, reduction = umap_red, features = "AtaCNV_chr7_ratio",
                  cols = c("#2166AC", "grey90", "#B2182B")) +
  ggtitle("Segmented chr7 Copy Ratio (BRAF Locus)")

combined_umap <- (p1 | p2) / (p3 | p4)
print(combined_umap)

ggsave(
  filename = paste0(cna_out_dir, sample_id, "_AtaCNV_UMAP_summary.pdf"),
  plot     = combined_umap,
  width    = 15,
  height   = 10
)

# Save updated Seurat object
out_seurat_rds <- file.path(output_dir, paste0(sample_id, "_multiome_merged_with_AtaCNV.rds"))
saveRDS(multiome_obj, file = out_seurat_rds)
cat("Saved updated Multiome object with AtaCNV results to:", out_seurat_rds, "\n")
```
